posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
The only thing in any of my games that I have put sleeves on is the SotM dividers. Works a treat. But give the people what they want, I say.

Back to the topic in hand, some things I would like to see in the KS are:

  • An errata'd oversized card for Gloomy Spite.
  • Foil versions of the base hero cards as well as the promos - and why not with new art too!
  • A booklet with a very brief overview of how each hero deck plays, including what nuances to expect with variant character cards, and put into groups of rough types (e.g. damage dealers, support, versatile).
  • Place cards for "All Heroes", "All VIllains", and "Environment" that we can chuck tokens onto for global effects. I have my own ones that I did a pnp on and they are nigh-on essential for me now, but I'd like to see an official take on this.
  • A place card for Setbacks tokens. Again I have my own pnp one which I couldn't play without now, but an official one would be nicer. I don't think we need special tokens as the HP ones are just fine so long as we have a meaningful place to store them.
  • Environments for TCF Stalwart, Citadel of the Sun, and Ft. Adamant (as others have also previously mentioned).
  • A timeline for the SotM story arc listing the main events and referencing the comic book numbers for those that want to dig deeper into flavour text etc. Not necessarily a big booklet full of in-depth essays, just an overview so we know which character variants and which villains go where in the timeline and what the significant canon battles are.
  • A bunch of promo cards for some of the alternate-reality heroes we saw in the ARG :slightly_smiling_face: I'm with Spiff on having lots more variant cards as it adds a nice additional dimension when choosing a hero to play.
 

I don't ask for much do I!

The first solution that comes into mind is a compendium that includes some information on all characters, villains, enviroments, and events, preferably in chronological order.

I did think of a another solution that I think should be on the unreasonable requests because of the sheer amount of content that would be, but I'll write it just in case. In the video game there are weekly scenarios with some small amount of background text as context. a "campaign book" made out of such scenarios detailing the plot of the game. describing big events with several scenarios, introducing the heroes and villains when they appear in the plot, maybe adding some special requirements for some scenarios. This campaign would take A LOT of work and will probably be a a rather thick book. 

I know that I had the ambition to try and make that campaign myself, but I know it would not be as good as an actual product made by GTG. Still, if this one wont be made by anyone else (and it will probably wont be) I would rather put the effort to make something that is not as good as it couldbe rather then not have it made at all

posts.name: Darkkami
posts.cooked:
I want to see a health tracker board. 

I made my own and it worked wonders for players, so I think it would make for a great stretch goal to be added to both KS and retail copies of the game.

My track only tracks the health of heroes, but it allows the players to see at a glance who has the second highest and/or lowest health for certain effects. Players can gage how to mitigate damage better, and it keeps the health token count low, while making for a clean presentation. My group and I are fine with using health tokens on villain targets because it creates this feeling of stacking damage on them, and they tend to have low health values anyways.

My track also has an area that indicates what the value of H is for the current game. 

The track as a whole is 7" squared and numbers 0 - 40. Each hero's health is tracked with a counter depicting their icon. H is tracked with a small wooden cube. 

 

Just an idea that has proven very helpful when I play the game with both new players and vets alike.
